scope: Common.OptimizeTool and Common.OptimizeTool.Samples; isolated Unity project
regressions: A+B to A rebuild restores removed source
ownership survives Undo/Redo and prefab instantiation
failed rebuild restores old mesh, output and ownership
cancel, disable, destroy and output failure restore workload/camera/settings exactly once
scale case/mode/custom camera restored on cancellation
stale completion, failed capture, duplicate capture ID, hash mismatch and nonfinite timing rejected
limitations: Player capture is an end-to-end smoke test, not a new performance study.
Legacy outputs without an ownership ledger cannot reconstruct original source visibility.
Historical capture format remains readable but has no v2 payload fingerprints.
No pointer-input validation was requested or performed.
